Your questions, drafts, answers, and files stay in Blobs on this phone. There is no account, analytics, cloud AI, or live web search.

The first-run model and library downloads happen only when you tap Download. Chat, search, answers, citations, and reading do not make network requests. You can also install packages from local storage.

Android backups are disabled. Uninstalling Blobs removes its private data. Export conversations before uninstalling if you want to keep them.

Getting ready
Add an answer-model package and a knowledge-library package using Add from this phone. Files are checked before they become available. Keep the original packages if you want to reinstall.

Asking questions
Ask for an explanation, comparison, or summary. Sources narrows the next answer. Blobs cannot see current events or anything missing from the installed library.

Reading evidence
Tap a numbered citation or a source row to read the saved passage. Source names, dates, credits, and original addresses are available here.

If something stops
Stop keeps partial work. Leaving the app stops an answer safely. Interrupted work can be tried again as a new answer. For an interrupted import, choose the same package again; installed files stay intact.

If a model cannot run
Close other apps and retry, or install a smaller model. File size alone does not guarantee compatibility.

Keeping your words
Export conversations before clearing app data or uninstalling. Exports are readable documents, not restorable backups.

Blobs 0.2.0
A little companion for big questions.

Answers run on your phone using llama.cpp. Sources are searched with SQLite FTS5. Model and library credits appear with each installed package.

Blobs uses AndroidX, Kotlin, Nunito, DM Sans, and Phosphor icons. Third-party notices are included below.
